# What every pipeline is designed to do

```{=html}
<div class="pipeline-stage-grid">

  <div class="pipeline-stage">

    <span>Identify cycles, components, files, and variables.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="pipeline-stage">
    <strong>Acquire</strong>
    <span>Download and preserve official source files.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="pipeline-stage">
    <strong>Validate</strong>
    <span>Inspect structures, keys, records, and completeness.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="pipeline-stage">
    <strong>Integrate</strong>
    <span>Harmonize cycles and merge components safely.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="pipeline-stage">

  </div>

</div>
```

# Pipeline architecture

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Configuration

Configuration files define:

- survey cycles;
- components;
- source files;
- source URLs;
- file roles;
- expected variables;
- local destinations.

## Acquisition

Acquisition functions:

- download source files;
- preserve raw files;
- record status;
- calculate hashes;
- document provenance.

## Validation

Validation functions inspect:

- file existence;
- import success;
- dimensions;
- variables;
- participant keys;
- duplicate records;
- missingness;
- expected relationships.

## Integration

Integration functions:

- add cycle provenance;
- harmonize names and classes;
- combine compatible cycles;
- preserve supplementary files;
- merge components;
- validate row relationships.

## Analysis and reporting

Final stages create:

- analysis-ready datasets;
- descriptive summaries;
- figure datasets;
- exported figures;
- dictionaries;
- execution logs;
- reproducibility evidence.

:::

# Pipeline readiness checklist

Before describing a pipeline as complete, confirm:

- [ ] Source files are listed explicitly.
- [ ] Survey cycles are retained.
- [ ] Primary and supplementary files are distinguished.
- [ ] Raw files are preserved unchanged.
- [ ] File hashes or equivalent provenance records are available.
- [ ] Expected variables are validated.
- [ ] Participant keys are checked.
- [ ] Duplicate records are investigated.
- [ ] Cycle compatibility is documented.
- [ ] Merge relationships are validated.
- [ ] Missingness is summarized.
- [ ] Survey-weight guidance is documented.
- [ ] Processed datasets are reusable.
- [ ] Tables and figures are reproducible.
- [ ] Analytical limitations are stated.
- [ ] The complete workflow runs from a clean process.

# Page summary

A reproducible NHANES pipeline should connect:

```text
scientific question
source files
laboratory context
survey design
data validation
analytical outputs
```

The pipeline catalog will expand as additional laboratory components and analytical methods are developed.

The first complete workflow is:

```text
Automated NHANES CBC and Demographic Data Pipeline in R
```
